* Expanded Content: Includes new custom stages, more blue coins, and togglable movesets like the long jump.

468231.overview: Super Monkey Ball 651 is a Story Mode exclusive hack developed by scrap651 over the course of 3 1/2 years, with music produced by Jim Nopédie being included in the final version.

470864.overview: Have a blast exploring the amazing Eclipse mod with a friend!

471170.overview:
Sonic Riders Future (SRF) is a brand new ROM Hack for Sonic Riders (2006) on the Nintendo GameCube. Vol. 1 is the first installment of SRF. The name and theme of the mod is heavily based on Jet Set Radio Future (2002), as it has similar connections between the aesthetic and gameplay. No matter if you are a causal or a veteran at Sonic Riders, there is plenty to enjoy in this mod!

The main direction of Sonic Riders Future is to create a lore-friendly Sonic Riders mod. This means the additional content would be created to fit seamlessly into the Sonic Riders universe by using the existing themes and designs that the franchise offers. We want to strike the balance between Sonic Riders' original gameplay while implementing innovative tweaks and QOL changes without adding them solely for the sake of innovation.

For many years in the Sonic Riders modding scene, the competitive side of Sonic Riders has been the main focus. We believe that catering to the causal side of the community is important to the longevity of the game. As seen in the comment sections from older Sonic Riders videos, we have come to the conclusion that there is a collective agreement that the people would love to see Sonic Riders with more content, particularly with more characters and stages. The raw numbers are in no interest to the majority of the community, all they just want is to play as their favourite characters and to have fun!

This is what we would like to achieve.

472425.overview: Super Smash Bros. ACE Build is an edition of Akaneia that adds community made characters and stages all in one place. One of the goals of the ACE Build is to put everything in one big community build for fun.

473631.overview: Super Monkey Ball Gaiden is a pack created by Cutsman. The pack would be critically acclaimed, with Cutsman becoming a level designer for the game Rolled Out! as a result. Super Monkey Ball Gaiden is best known for having extremely tough and long levels, and only a handful of people have beaten the Master difficulty.

477376.overview: Welcome to the sun-drenched-tropical-paradise of isle Delfino, now at a later time of day. Super Mario Sunset transforms the familiar bright and sunny locales of of Mario Sunshine into a laid-back, chill and softer light environment. Every location has received a facelift and hue swapped. Some locations look brand new! It's more than that too, there are repainted bosses, new music and sound effects, and a couple of new models too! Playing to the very end will grant you access to a brand new 120 shine reward level known as "Delfino Festival". Give Sunset a try for your next Sunshine playthrough, we hope you enjoy the visuals as much we had making them.

481767.overview: The Super Mario Sunshine Randomizer focuses on swapping around the levels and loading zones to present a fresh Mario Sunshine experience. Each of the game's levels will present you with a random loading zone, with your ultimate aim to navigate the chaos and defeat Shadow Mario in the seven stages as usual. To make things even more interesting though, you'll only start with the ability to move and jump, with other abilities—even FLUDD's various nozzles—needing to be found via special rainbow Shine Sprites.

481781.overview: A recreation of the dungeon from Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door. Battle through new and old enemies, grow stronger as you go, and face off against a fully custom boss! Playthrough Boss Fight.

481926.overview:
Patrick's entire sock collection has gone missing! Run, Jump and Roll your way through Bikini Bottom to find Patrick's 1000 missing socks! Visit unseen parts of levels to find where those pesky robots hid all of Patrick's socks!

Featuring: revamped objectives, challenging levels, and difficult boss fights, as well as two BRAND NEW "powers" to aid in your adventure!

There's 3 different "endings" depending on how many socks you find, can you stop the robots from rampaging yet again???
